description: This Swift source file defines a set of asynchronous static functions within the enum 'SessionActions' that manage session-related operations, including patching, resetting, deleting, and compacting sessions, as well as UI interactions like confirming destructive actions, presenting errors, and opening session logs. It interacts with external components such as 'ControlChannel', 'NSAlert', 'NSWorkspace', and handles file and process operations.

methods.name: patchSession
methods.description: Asynchronously patches a session with optional thinking and verbose levels by sending a request through ControlChannel.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a session identified by the key via ControlChannel request.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a session identified by the key and its transcript.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts a session by reducing its lines up to a maximum specified value.

methods.name: confirmDestructiveAction
methods.description: Displays a warning alert for destructive actions, returning true if the user confirms.

methods.name: presentError
methods.description: Displays an error alert with a specified title and error details.

methods.name: openSessionLogInCode
methods.description: Attempts to open a session log file in code editor or file viewer based on sessionId and optional storePath.
